description:
Advances: ancora.tasks

Severity: Medium (calibrated; critical review 2026-09-05, consolidated F22, frontend). Evidence: ancora.tasks specifies that --explain-acks lists only acknowledged findings, so on a failing run the blocking errors are absent from the listing a human reads. Question to decide: should the flag add the acknowledged findings to the normal visible list instead of replacing it? Spec change plus output change plus goldens. Ready-for: investigate.
title: Decide whether --explain-acks adds to or replaces the visible finding list
